name: velixir
description: Put the app you just built live in the EU in one step. Deploy a web app in any language to velixir with no account and no Dockerfile, get a live URL and a claim link, then read build, runtime and access logs to fix what you shipped.

velixir_api_key.title: velixir API key (optional)
velixir_api_key.description: Only needed to read access logs for apps you own, by app ID. Leave empty to deploy without an account. Create a key at velixir.net under Settings, API keys.
